_about: C. G. Jung (1875-1961), Swiss psychiatrist, founder of analytical psychology; his English translations of 1915-1917. Gutenberg: The Theory of Psychoanalysis (1915); Psychology of the Unconscious (tr. Beatrice M. Hinkle, 1916); Collected Papers on Analytical Psychology (ed. Constance E. Long, 1916). Translators are recorded as Gutenberg names them; Freud is on another thread's freud shelf and is not duplicated here. US public domain (all published 1930 or earlier). No uids minted.
